title: Estrangement Between Banda Singh And Tat Khalsa

blocks.text: The Guru Mother’s message to the Khalsa sharply distinguishes the Khalsa from Banda, insisting that the Singhs belong to the Guru and Panth rather than to Banda’s personal line or camp.
The page instructs them in practical separation—food, treasury, and institutional loyalty are to remain with Khalsa discipline, not Banda’s private authority.
Guru Mother is the essential anchor because the whole later estrangement begins from her moral and spiritual intervention.
